verifications.test: Data lineage and numerical consistency from block NWP forecasts to canonical storage
verifications.expected: No numerical value alteration or hallucination across canonical storage and downscaling tables
verifications.actual: Numerical forecast values remain identical to source downscaling outputs without distortion

verifications.test: District -> Block -> Panchayat progressive spatial resolution and LGD compliance
verifications.expected: Parent-child spatial lineage resolves unambiguously for Nashik (15 blocks) and Pune (14 blocks)
verifications.actual: Hierarchy resolution validates parent references, coordinates, and elevation with zero cross-district leakage

verifications.test: Production single-record downscaling inference with Random Forest and XGBoost frozen models
verifications.expected: Loads serialized joblib artifact with matching 8-feature schema without retrain or ground-truth leakage
verifications.actual: Inference produces deterministic downscaled rainfall output with non-negativity constraint and NaN/Inf guards

verifications.test: Agronomic rule evaluation against IMD rainfall thresholds and operational guidelines
verifications.expected: Deterministic risk severity, operational rules, and agronomic recommendations generated without AI dependence
verifications.actual: Evaluates all 7 IMD categories deterministically; produces repeatable advisory outputs with explicit rule versioning

verifications.test: Strongly-typed spatial, forecast, and deterministic rule context assembly
verifications.expected: Rejects missing panchayats, invalid forecasts, or date mismatches; passes valid contexts
verifications.actual: AdvisoryContext assembly strictly enforces schema contracts and spatial grounding

verifications.test: Vendor-agnostic AI advisory generation via mock provider with structured output validation
verifications.expected: Produces AIAdvisoryOutputContract conforming to prompt versioning without modifying numerical forecast values
verifications.actual: Generates structured title, summary, reasons, actions, and warnings; mock provider executes deterministically offline
verifications.known_issue: Cloud LLM provider integration verified with deterministic mock provider in test environment; live API requires external provider keys

verifications.test: Automated guardrail inspection for numerical hallucination, chemical safety, and unsupported diagnosis
verifications.expected: Rejects modified rainfall values, ungrounded chemical mixing instructions, or panic statements
verifications.actual: Safety validator catches altered numbers, ungrounded risks, and dangerous chemical advice with HTTP 422 / fallback

verifications.test: Fallback activation when AI provider times out, fails, or emits ungrounded output
verifications.expected: Seamless deterministic fallback to Phase 5.2 rule engine with zero invented advice
verifications.actual: Fallback generates verified rule-based guidance marked ADVISORY_SOURCE: DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK

verifications.test: Extension officer queue, editing, rejection with required reason, and audit logging
verifications.expected: Edits re-validated for safety; original content immutable; rejected status cannot be published
verifications.actual: State transitions (NEEDS_REVIEW -> EDITED -> APPROVED/REJECTED) enforced with full audit history

verifications.test: Concurrent edit protection using monotonic advisory version numbers
verifications.expected: Rejects stale version modifications with HTTP 409 Conflict
verifications.actual: Detects version race conditions and prevents silent overwrites across concurrent review sessions

verifications.test: Strict backend isolation of unapproved, draft, generated, or rejected advisories from farmers
verifications.expected: Only status == 'APPROVED' advisories returned to farmer endpoints; unapproved returns clean empty state
verifications.actual: Farmer endpoint serves only APPROVED advisories; drafts and rejected records produce clean empty response

verifications.test: GET /api/v1/farmer/panchayat/{id} endpoint with 3-tier presentation structure and version badge
verifications.expected: Delivers what_is_happening, why_it_matters, recommended_actions, timing, warnings, and version badge
verifications.actual: Returns farmer-safe structured payload stripped of internal LLM prompts, officer IDs, and debug metadata

verifications.test: Farmer app rendering 3-tier advisory flow, officer verification seal, and offline cache notice
verifications.expected: Clean UI presentation across 320px compact to standard tablets; seamless tab navigation; zero crashes
verifications.actual: 56/56 Flutter tests pass; clean APK build (flutter build apk --debug) verified

verifications.test: English ('en'), Marathi ('mr'), and Hindi ('hi') advisory localization with numerical immutability
verifications.expected: Numerical rainfall (e.g. 24.5 mm), dates, and severity remain identical across all 3 languages
verifications.actual: Controlled peer-reviewed agronomic templates preserve exact numbers and units across en, mr, and hi

verifications.test: Officer review UI with hierarchy selection, edit modal, approval flow, and audit trail
verifications.expected: TypeScript check and Vite production build pass; vitest test suite passes
verifications.actual: 23/23 tests pass; tsc && vite build succeeds in 7.04s generating production dist/

verifications.test: Audit for leaked Supabase service keys, AI provider secrets, or hardcoded passwords
verifications.expected: Zero private keys, tokens, or credentials in Git, Flutter, or React client bundles
verifications.actual: Clients consume public endpoints with role validation; Supabase service-role key restricted to backend env

verifications.test: Foreign key relationships and schema constraints on advisories and downscaled_forecasts
verifications.expected: Panchayat foreign keys strictly enforced; cascade deletes configured safely for test cleanup
verifications.actual: PostgreSQL relational integrity verified across panchayats, forecasts, advisories, and audit logs
